description:
FOUND s492b (2026-09-21) by A/B-ing every companion mover against a 5ce155cb `git archive`
extraction (scratch/s492b/log-movers-{base,tree}.txt, both `--jobs 1`, back to back).  Four files
move against the blessed snapshot ON THE BASE TOO, so s492b did not cause them and, per the brief's
rule, did not splice them:

  file                 snapshot        BASE 5ce155cb   s492b tree      caused by s492b?
  op/alarm.t           OK    5/0       DIFF  4/1       DIFF  4/1       NO  (-1 passing row)
  op/coreamp.t         DIFF  9/58      DIFF 10/57      DIFF 10/57      NO  (+1)
  re/pat_re_eval.t     DIFF 65/462     STALE 80/447    STALE 80/447    NO  (+15, and the runner
                                                                        says 25 registered rows no
                                                                        longer diverge)
  run/switches.t       DIFF 28/112     DIFF 29/111     DIFF 29/111     NO  (+1)

op/alarm.t is the one that LOSES a row ("alarm w/$SIG{ALRM} vs system()"), and both sides print
`reaped 12 orphan(s)`, so it is the likeliest to be a timing artefact rather than a code change --
but that is a guess, and the snapshot says OK, so the file is worth one look before it is re-blessed.

THE RULE THAT KEEPS THIS OPEN (s421): "pre-existing" is WHEN, not WHY -- a snapshot row is spliced
only with its cause.  So the next session that touches the companion baselines should, per file,
bisect between the snapshot's own commit and 5ce155cb (or probe the row directly) and edit the row
with what it finds.  re/pat_re_eval.t additionally wants `--bless-rows` for its 25 no-longer-diverging
registered rows, which is a separate, cheap act.

NOT in this list, and why: io/pvbm.t (parallel 21/7, serial 20/8, alone 23/5 = the long-known
contention file -- base and tree both 23/5 serially), io/crlf_through.t (TIMEOUT under contention,
serial OK 942/0 = the snapshot), uni/variables.t (TIMEOUT, load-dependent row count, the runner does
not compare it), re/charset.t and re/regexp_unicode_prop.t (row-description churn -- #2032).
subject: COMPANION SNAPSHOT (pre-existing on main): four baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv rows disagree with what 5ce155cb itself measures -- op/alarm.t, op/coreamp.t, re/pat_re_eval.t, run/switches.t; each needs a CAUSE before it can be re-blessed
